bindings.caption: Prepare PbO, oleic acid and1-octadecene in2L three-neck reactor. For non-example conditions, the common large-scale method is inherited with OA/initialODE adjusted at constant total volume. Exact individual volumes remain unknown; no graph coordinates inferred. Mainp2 uses50cm double-wall reflux condenser; TableS1 lists >50cm overall condenser height, internal cooling coil, elliptic50mm×20mm stirrer and2L three-neck flask. Dimensions are source annotations, not a scale drawing. Mainp2 requires supported reactor and source-limited thermal-difference precautions; no new apparatus specification supplied. Continuing source reactor:2L, three necks, reflux condenser; schematic scale.
Load addition funnel with sulfur precursor and dried1-octadecene. Load addition funnel with sulfur precursor and dried1-octadecene Vessel geometry is not assigned to this source stage.
Heat reactor at150°C under vacuum for2h. Heat reactor at150°C under vacuum for2h Continuing source reactor:2L, three necks, reflux condenser; schematic scale.
Backfill with nitrogen and stabilize temperature. Backfill with nitrogen and stabilize temperature Continuing source reactor:2L, three necks, reflux condenser; schematic scale.

Apply mild vacuum, then close vacuum valve before opening addition funnel. Remove heating mantle first. Apply vacuum for a few seconds to1–10mbar; close vacuum valve before injection. Source reactor remains2L three-neck with reflux condenser and bottom support. Continuing source reactor:2L, three necks, reflux condenser; schematic scale.

Open funnel stopcock; finish injection within3s and close stopcock. Heating mantle removed. Addition funnel and reactor isolated from vacuum pump during injection; do not maintain pumping through the feed. Continuing source reactor:2L, three necks, reflux condenser; schematic scale.
Naturally cool to100°C over4min without heating mantle. Naturally cool to100°C over4min without heating mantle Continuing source reactor:2L, three necks, reflux condenser; schematic scale.
Reinstall heating mantle; maintain100°C for5min. Reinstall heating mantle; maintain100°C for5min Continuing source reactor:2L, three necks, reflux condenser; schematic scale.

Terminate with a water bath. Source water bath termination; no unreported bath temperature assigned. Mainp2 glassware cooling precautions retained as source context. Continuing source reactor:2L, three necks, reflux condenser; schematic scale.

Mix crude with hexane and acetone; centrifuge and discard supernatant. Turbidity after acetone addition; retain PbS precipitate. general_background.title: Injection and precursor supply
general_background.summary: Rapid injection can concentrate precursor conversion near the start of a reaction, helping distinguish nucleation from subsequent growth. A short period of rapid precursor conversion can favour nucleation, while a later lower supply can favour growth on existing particles.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation

general_background.title: Carboxylic-acid and carboxylate ligands
general_background.summary: Carboxylic acids and carboxylates can associate with metal-containing surfaces and solution species through their oxygen groups. The hydrocarbon part of a long-chain ligand can favour dispersion in a compatible solvent, while acid-base equilibria influence how its head group associates.
